invest.title: Total investment
invest.text: Unit price + furniture/setup capex. Reserve budget for acquisition costs (transfer tax, registration, deed).

revenue.title: Net monthly revenue
revenue.text: Rent or daily × occupancy, minus condo fees, property tax, platform (~18%) and cleaning/management (~12% in short stay).

yield.title: Annual yield
yield.text: Annual net revenue ÷ total investment. Compare with local interest rate + real estate spread in the region.

payback.title: Payback & appreciation
payback.text: Time to recover the investment with rental income + potential appreciation between plan and delivery.

avaliar.title: Investor checklist before making the call.
avaliar.subtitle: A good unit is chosen by objective criteria. Use this checklist at the sales stand and when analyzing the price sheet.
items: Actual walking distance to subway, universities and employment hubs (not straight line).
Floor, sun orientation and view — impact daily rate and rental speed.
Usable private area vs. total advertised area.
Projected condo fee per sqm and extra dues (construction fund, reserve).
Internal rules for short-term rentals (condo bylaws).
Delivery date and track record of the developer.
Air-conditioning infra, piped gas and network points.
Comparables (asking price and closed rentals) within 1 km.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions for investors
faq.a1: The feasibility of short-term rentals depends on the condominium's bylaws, which have not yet been established. We recommend confirming this with the sales team and, later, with the condo association.
faq.q2: What tenant profile should I expect?
faq.a2: Given the surroundings — subway, universities and employment hubs nearby — the most likely profile is students and young professionals seeking practicality and mobility, without relying on a car.
faq.q3: Is it worth it without a parking spot?
faq.a3: Units without a parking spot were designed to lower the entry ticket and attract an audience that uses public transport — something favored by the mere 900 m distance to Vila Mariana subway.
faq.a4: Use our simulation tool to estimate installments, down payment and term, and talk to the sales team to learn about Vila Park's specific conditions.
faq.q5: When does it start generating income?
faq.a5: Rental income is only possible after the keys are delivered. Talk to the sales team to find out the delivery timeline.

f1.q: Long-term rental or short stay — which yields more in Vila Mariana?
f1.a: It depends on management style and condo bylaws. Short stay tends to have higher daily rates, but operating costs (platform, cleaning) and vacancy are also higher. The simulator above lets you compare both scenarios with your own numbers.

f2.q: What's the average cost to furnish a unit?
f2.a: For studios and 1-bedrooms in Vila Mariana, furniture and setup capex typically ranges from BRL 25k (essential), BRL 55k (premium) and BRL 95k+ (signature). The higher the standard, the higher the supported daily — but also the capex payback time.

f3.q: How do I assess if the unit's price is aligned with the market?
f3.a: Compare price per private sqm with active listings and recent transactions within 1 km, prioritizing launches with equivalent finishing standards. Discounts for the absence of a parking spot are normal in products like Vila Park.

f4.q: Do I need a company (CNPJ) to run short stay?
f4.a: Not mandatory to start, but depending on volume and tax strategy, operating through a legal entity (Lucro Presumido) is usually more efficient. Consult your accountant to model taxation and asset protection.

f5.q: What changes in my return if I buy off-plan vs. ready?
f5.a: Off-plan usually involves lower price per sqm and appreciation potential until delivery, with the trade-off of time without income and execution risk. Ready delivers immediate income, but at a higher price and no curve gain.
